This '''clone navigation officer''' served under [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on the bridge of her [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]]. He informed her of the arrival of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] and the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].
